author: Animalogic
description:
Meet "Dakota," a fossil that has revolutionized our understanding of dinosaur anatomy. This specimen provided scientists with the first evidence that duck-billed dinosaurs, such as the Edmontosaurus, possessed real hooves supported by nail beds.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
